releaseNotes:
## ✨ What's New

### 🗂️ Scheduler Task Editing and History

- Create, edit, duplicate and change the status of scheduled tasks.
- Execution history is preserved using stable schedule entry IDs.
- File writes are guarded against conflicts, and disabled queued runs are cancelled.

### 💬 Pip Channels: Thread Sessions and Recovery

- Threads now own durable per-thread Pip sessions, with migrations that preserve legacy history.
- Thread isolation and per-Pip execution limits are enforced.
- Interrupted work is kept uncertain rather than silently dropped, and replaced sessions are quarantined.
- New IPC and UI controls support session recovery and approvals, with localized recovery guidance.
- Thread replies have persisted ordering and bidirectional pagination, and reading position is preserved across refreshes.

### 🧠 Vocabulary Designer Chat and Graph Preview

- New vocabulary designer session with chat and graph preview (ADR-030).
- Reworked editor layout: slim header, full-width canvas, toolbar tabs.
- Preview chat runs tests via Test on this; other tabs ask the assistant.
- New GraphCanvas component shared with the Project graph overview.

### 🧩 Studio: Orchestrate Agent Packages

- Create one agent with independently callable bundled skills.
- Reuses Single agent chat, model selection and attachments.
- Validated drafts, global deployment and marketplace bundles.
- Save flow aligns agent and skills to the selected Studio destination.

### 💳 Credits: Guided Recovery and Weekly Activity

- Credits-exhausted card with model switch and extension request.
- Pool-aware budget state, renewal date and My requests.
- Weekly Activity navigation with date picker and period marker.
- Activity now shows the credit funding source.

### 🗂️ Projects: Local Workspaces

- Link local workspace folders to Compass projects, with a roots editor and reconciliation of device roots.

## 🛠️ Improvements

- Marketplace: manage account sources, with device sources preserved and catalog caches invalidated on change.
- Chat: organisation maintenance notice card with a retry button when the service is unavailable.
- Chat: project chat menu floats over messages; the current chat is hidden from history; virtualized message heights are preserved on replay.
- Sidebar: new chat/project actions moved to a header icon; workspace header overflow fixed.
- MCP: Higgsfield added to the tool gallery; Supadata built-in tool removed.
- Design: oversized previews are supported; stale undo history is cleared without surfacing an error.
- Pip channels: redundant status UI removed; completed-turn chip shows only when a reply is missing.
- Translations updated across English, German, Spanish and European Portuguese.

## 🐛 Bug Fixes

- Designer policy is limited to workflow chats and no longer leaks into Project chats.
- Conversation menu overlays messages without affecting layout.
- Vocabulary Preview chat is test-only; empty-chat hints render as plain text.
- Orchestrate save flow aligns agent and skills and handles save conflicts and retries.

## ⚙️ Under the Hood

- ADR-029 (credits UX and recovery) marked Accepted with implementation notes; ADR-030 defines agent Studio Orchestrate packages; the Activity funding decision moved to ADR-032.
- Application version metadata was bumped to **1.0.25**, with dependencies refreshed.
- Expanded regression coverage for scheduler, Pip thread sessions, maintenance card and vocabulary confirmations.
